errors.text_span: the vertical axis represents performance scores, labeled from 0 to 100 with a linear scale and tick intervals of 10
errors.evidence: The figure’s MATH-500 panels use a y-axis from about 65 to 100 with ticks every 5, while the AIME24 panels use 0 to 90 with ticks every 10; it is not a single 0–100 axis across the whole chart.
In the legend and bars, Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct is green, not orange; orange corresponds to DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B.
The figure’s TTS bars are white with diagonal hatch marks, not brown; brown corresponds to o1-preview.
GPT-4o is shown in purple, but not specifically dark purple; the machine description’s color mapping is not consistent with the legend styling and is misleading.
o1-preview is shown in brown, while dark red corresponds to DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B.
The figure shows DeepSeek-R1 as beige/yellow and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B as orange with diagonal hatching; gray corresponds to o1.

The description does not clearly state that the chart compares compute-optimal test-time scaling (TTS) against CoT performance across smaller and larger LLMs, which is the purpose indicated by the title/caption and visible labels.

The description does not mention the legend’s key distinction between CoT and TTS styles, including the hatching used for TTS and the white style for CoT, nor the separate subpanels (a)–(f) grouped under MATH-500 and AIME24.
